items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter came out with his friend, George Rich... and the two of them came out in Rich's new Cadillac, and Benny Carter came and heard me... and he liked what I was doing and hired me

ctx.x: And that attracted them, so they got me to play there, and John Hammond heard me on the radio, because the New York stations -- when it's one o'clock in New York, they went off the air -- at the same time, we were coming on the air in Chicago at midnight. So John Hammond heard me, and he was already a friend of Benny Carter in New York and told Benny Carter about me.

So Benny Carter came out with his friend, George Rich, who was one of the richest racketeers in Harlem in those days, a very unusual man, and a real jazz fan and crazy about Benny Carter -- and the two of them came out in Rich's new Cadillac, and Benny Carter came and heard me, you know, and he liked what I was doing and hired me and then he hired Keg.
